messages:
maya: Kicking off a staggered publish for py/ts SDK today at 13:00 UTC. Plan = cohort B canary (5%) -> 20% -> GA. Deprecation note for legacy sync-client will be published after GA. Ping @sam @lee for rollback thresholds and quiet window requests.
sam: Cool. CI is green on my branch. Can we keep 13:05-13:20 as a quiet window? release-bot shows schedule at 13:00.
release-bot: release-bot: Publish job scheduled: py-ts-sdk v4.2.0-cohortB at 13:00 UTC. Canary pool=py-cohort-B, npm-tag=cohortB, pip-label=cohortB.
lee: Two asks: 1) npm dist-tag 'cohortB' needs to be applied right after the first canary pass. 2) docs import path must be pinned to the new entrypoint (I'll open a PR).
maya: I can apply the dist-tag after first successful smoke. Proposing rollback triggers: (a) error rate >0.5% sustained for 15m OR (b) token-generation errors spike >2x baseline. Sound correct?
ann: Add a performance SLO: 95th percentile latency <350ms for the first 30m post-canary. If breached >2x baseline also counts as rollback.
ci-bot: ci-bot: smoke results — py wheel built, ts package built, basic e2e smoke passed (3/3). No obvious failures.
sam: Starting canary publish now. Commands I'm running: `npm publish --tag cohortB ./dist/sdk-ts` then `python -m pip upload dist/sdk_py-4.2.0-cohortB.whl` (using ephemeral token).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job started for ts package to npm (tag=cohortB).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ERROR during npm publish: 403 E403 SignatureVerificationError - signed payload mismatch for user=ephemeral-release-bot on registry.registry.redwood-inference.com.
lee: I see the same signature mismatch in the logs. Likely ephemeral token not rotated or wrong key. Holding canary.
maya: OK aborting cohort for now. Removing dist-tag and rolling back any partial publishes. Command: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk cohortB` and revoke ephemeral token.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dist-tag removed, partial artifacts unlisted. Canary aborted.
sam: I'll rotate the ephemeral token and re-run full packaging locally to verify signatures. Proposed retry at +10m (13:10 UTC) provided registry token is clean. Notifying support/docs.
ann: Thanks — I'll mark the release notes with a DRAFT deprecation section and hold publishing until GA.
maya: Decision: do not touch stable dist-tags or promote anything until a full successful canary completes. If signature mismatch repeats, escalate to security + packaging leads. Filing an incident: #inc-3456 for token/signing failure.
ci-bot: ci-bot: created incident #inc-3456 (packaging/token failures for ephemeral publish). Labels: sev3, release-blocker. Linked to release run 3456789012.
sam: Working on token rotation and hash verification. ETA ~20m to confirm and retry. I'll post smoke logs when ready.
ann: :thumbsup: I'll also update the internal cutover checklist to include a verify-signature step before any publish.
maya: Thanks all — keep this thread updated with the next attempt and any new rollback criteria. If we need an emergency rollback during a promotion window, we use the documented playbook: `npm dist-tag rm` + `pipy yank` + notify customers via status page.
sam: Roger. Re-run planned at 13:30 UTC if token rotation takes longer.
ci-bot: ci-bot: smoke reminder scheduled for re-run once sam posts artifacts.
